name: Burning Ashes

pages.text: Obtain from an Ignited Revenant and place in an Altar of Fire to summon Ignis.

pages.title: Source
pages.text: Ignited Revenants at the Burning Arena drop Burning Ashes. A sufficiently strong axe hit counters their shields; a fully charged critical is a suitable method.

pages.title: Offering
pages.text: Interact with the Altar of Fire while holding the ashes. The altar accepts one item into its slot. A successful summon consumes the offering; an unrelated item does not summon Ignis.

pages.title: Next
pages.text: On a dedicated server, summoning and starting a hosted fight are separate: use Start in preparation. Singleplayer uses native activation. $(l:handbook/bosses/cataclysm/ignis)Ignis tactics$(/l).
